IC1: Patients with a histologically [OR], radiologically [OR] or haematologically confirmed malignancy [AND] whose pain is judged by the investigator to be caused by the malignancy
IC2: Patients must have been on a stable daily dose of weak opioids [OR] or strong opioids for at least 72 hours prior to the start the study and must remain at the same dosage for the duration of the study
IC3: Patients must have a VAS (Visual analog scale) >=40mm
